title: AllowlistEntry
description: An IP allowlist entry representing a CIDR range authorized to connect to a CockroachDB cluster.

cidr_ip.description: IPv4 address of the CIDR range.

cidr_mask.description: Prefix length of the CIDR range.

name.description: Human-readable label for this allowlist entry.

ui.description: Whether this entry grants access to the DB Console (UI), in addition to SQL.

sql.description: Whether this entry grants SQL access.
